ci-report: Write an Artifact page for my team lead about why our CI got slower and flakier this quarter, and what we should do. Data, median CI minutes by month: Jan 11, Feb 12, Mar 14, Apr 19, May 23, Jun 24. Failed runs by cause this quarter (Apr-Jun): flaky browser tests 142, dependency download timeouts 61, real test failures 38, out-of-disk on runners 17. In April we added a 40-test browser suite that runs on every push; in May the runner pool shrank from 12 to 8 machines. Options we discussed: run browser tests only on merge to main; cache dependencies; add back 4 runners (cost 600 USD a month). Save it as page.html in the current folder; do not publish it.
queue-explainer: Write an Artifact page that explains to a new engineer how our job queue service works. Files: api/server.py (HTTP entry, POST /jobs and GET /jobs/<id>), queue/store.py (SQLite table jobs with status queued/running/done/failed), queue/lease.py (a worker leases a job for 60 s, renews every 20 s), worker/main.py (loop: lease, run, mark done or failed), worker/retry.py (failed jobs retried up to 3 times with backoff 10 s, 40 s, 160 s), ops/metrics.py (exports queue depth and lease expiries). A request: a client POSTs a job, the API writes it queued, a worker leases it, runs it, marks it done; if the worker dies, the lease expires and another worker takes it. Common traps: long jobs that forget to renew the lease run twice; retries are not idempotent unless the job checks its own output. Save it as page.html in the current folder; do not publish it.
cache-proposal: Write an Artifact page proposing which cache we should put in front of our product-search API, for the team to agree on. Current p95 latency 480 ms, 2,000 requests per second at peak, 70% of queries repeat within 10 minutes. Options: (A) in-process LRU per server: p95 estimate 120 ms, cost 0 USD, stale up to 10 min, hit rate 55% because 8 servers each hold their own; (B) shared Redis: p95 estimate 90 ms, cost 350 USD a month, invalidation on product update, hit rate 68%; (C) CDN edge cache: p95 estimate 60 ms, cost 900 USD a month, stale up to 5 min, cannot cache logged-in results (40% of traffic). We need p95 under 150 ms and stale prices for no more than 1 minute, because a price shown wrong is a support ticket. Save it as page.html in the current folder; do not publish it.
